data.summary:
Driven by a passion for technology and innovation, I excelled at American Chase, mastering AWS, Workday configuration, and PRISM Analytics.
My proactive approach in developing user-centric solutions and optimizing cloud integrations showcases my technical proficiency and collaborative spirit, significantly enhancing project outcomes and operational efficiency.

responsibilities: Designed and implemented Workday integrations using EIBs, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, and web services (REST/SOAP) to ensure seamless data exchange.
Configured secure file transfers (SFTP) and utilized XSLT for data transformation and mapping.
PRISM Analyst: Expertise in creating derived and base datasets, managing data change tasks, and implementing table transformations to enhance reporting efficiency in Workday.
Developed and maintained integration solutions for Payroll, Benefits, Employee Retirement Plans, and other HR systems.
Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver scalable, efficient integration solutions.
Provisioned and configured Amazon EC2 instances to meet specific project requirements, including selecting appropriate instance types, operating systems, and storage options.
Designed user-friendly software interfaces to simplify overall management.

Integrated AWS Simple Notification Service (SNS) to enable real-time notifications to subscribers through various channels, like email, SMS, or other messaging protocols, enhancing communication and alerting capabilities within the system.
Implemented AWS Amplify to streamline the development and deployment of web and mobile applications, accelerating time to market, and reducing development complexity.
Developed responsive and user-friendly web interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, ensuring cross-browser compatibility and accessibility
Utilized modern CSS features like Flexbox and Grid layout to create flexible and scalable page layouts, improving code maintainability and efficiency

Conducted performance optimization and debugging of JavaScript code using browser developer tools (e.g., Chrome DevTools), identifying and resolving bottlenecks to improve overall application performance.

raw_sections.summary:
SUMMARY
Driven by a passion for technology and innovation, I excelled at American Chase, mastering AWS, Workday configuration, and PRISM Analytics. My proactive approach in developing user-centric solutions and optimizing cloud integrations showcases my technical proficiency and collaborative spirit, significantly enhancing project outcomes and operational efficiency.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE SKILLS
Programming Languages: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, Java, Python, C, C++
Cloud & DevOps Tools: AWS, Git, AWS SNS, AWS Amplify
Workday & Integration Tools: Workday Studio, Core Connectors, EIBs, SFTP, XSLT, REST/SOAP web services
Database & Analytics: MongoDB, PRISM Analytics
Frameworks & Libraries: Django, MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js)
raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
American Chase — Indore, India
Software Development Engineer
August 2023 – Present
Workday Technology Project:
Designed and implemented Workday integrations using EIBs, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, and web services (REST/SOAP) to ensure seamless data exchange.
Configured secure file transfers (SFTP) and utilized XSLT for data transformation and mapping.
PRISM Analyst: Expertise in creating derived and base datasets, managing data change tasks, and implementing table transformations to enhance reporting efficiency in Workday.
Developed and maintained integration solutions for Payroll, Benefits, Employee Retirement Plans, and other HR systems.
Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver scalable, efficient integration solutions.
AWS Cloud Project:
Provisioned and configured Amazon EC2 instances to meet specific project requirements, including selecting appropriate instance types, operating systems, and storage options.
Designed user-friendly software interfaces to simplify overall management.
Integrated AWS Simple Notification Service (SNS) to enable real-time notifications to subscribers through various channels, like email, SMS, or other messaging protocols, enhancing communication and alerting capabilities within the system.
Implemented AWS Amplify to streamline the development and deployment of web and mobile applications, accelerating time to market, and reducing development complexity.
Suvidha Foundation — Gwalior, India
Web Developer Intern
June 2022 – July 2022
Developed responsive and user-friendly web interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, ensuring cross-browser compatibility and accessibility
Utilized modern CSS features like Flexbox and Grid layout to create flexible and scalable page layouts, improving code maintainability and efficiency
Conducted performance optimization and debugging of JavaScript code using browser developer tools (e.g., Chrome DevTools), identifying and resolving bottlenecks to improve overall application performance.
